blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — A 21-year-old construction worker was arrested on Thursday night when police caught him with about 43 kilograms of marijuana at Puguis in the Benguet capital town of La Trinidad. Police officers from the La Trinidad Municipal Police Station were conducting patrol operations in the area when they spotted two parked vehicles and saw a man transferring boxes from a larger vehicle to the trunk of the other car. Upon inspection, police noticed tubular-shaped objects inside the containers. The suspect tried to flee when he saw the officers but was apprehended. The occupants of the larger vehicle escaped.
